output.summary: A North American genus of nitrogen-fixing shrubs and small trees, native from Canada through the United States and Mexico to Panama. Members may be evergreen or deciduous, thorny or unarmed, with flowers ranging from cream and deep blue to pink; some regrow from roots after fire, while others reproduce only from seed.
output.edibilityNote: Native Americans brewed dried leaves as herbal tea, and early pioneers used the plant as a black-tea substitute.
